_execution_mode_note: paper | live. Flipping to live changes which Broker implementation the Execution Agent uses. It does NOT remove the approval gate -- that sits above both.

materiality._note: Sum of four 0-3 axes: price_move, thesis_impact, novelty, position_weight. >=8 alerts immediately, 5-7 goes in the next scheduled report, below 5 is logged only.

_options_source_note: schwab | none. Enables the Technical Analyst's options section.

live_direct._note: Both gates apply only to execution_mode=live_direct. require_confirmation_link routes the final submit through Webull's instruction flow so a human still sees the ticket. require_attended_session refuses direct execution in a scheduled run, falling back to live_instruction. Turning either off is a deliberate decision, not a default.
